first.rationale: Onboarding completion is down 4% QoQ, which directly maps to the domain where we have the strongest precedent (memory_31 and memory_86 both showed durable lift from signup/onboarding simplification). While competitor pricing pressure is real, responding to it with promotional_pricing risks eroding margins on accounts we should be retaining at full value. Activation messaging (memory_91) is a secondary lever but onboarding friction is upstream and likely causal to the activation decline. Referral_incentive and enterprise_sales_assist, while validated, are less directly connected to our current metrics deterioration. Simplifying onboarding targets the root of both reported problems and has proven durable returns. We verify the two most recent onboarding experiments to confirm effect sizes and identify any segment interactions or implementation nuances before rolling out.
